title: Certified JavaScript Developer
overview: The Certified JavaScript Developer course is designed to provide a comprehensive understanding of JavaScript programming, including its core concepts, advanced features, and application in web development. This course prepares participants for the Certified JavaScript Developer exam by covering essential JavaScript skills, best practices, and modern development techniques.
audience: Web developers and programmers seeking to enhance their JavaScript skills.
IT professionals preparing for the Certified JavaScript Developer certification exam.
Individuals looking to specialize in JavaScript for front-end or back-end development.
Anyone interested in mastering JavaScript programming and best practices.
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: Detailed explanations of JavaScript concepts, syntax, and features.
Hands-On Labs: Practical coding exercises and projects to apply JavaScript skills.
Case Studies: Real-world scenarios to understand JavaScript application in various contexts.
Group Discussions: Interactive sessions to explore JavaScript development challenges and solutions.
Quizzes and Practice Exams: Assessments to evaluate understanding and readiness for the certification exam.
competencies: Web development with JavaScript frameworks and libraries
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: To provide a thorough understanding of JavaScript programming and its modern features.
To prepare participants for the Certified JavaScript Developer exam.
To equip learners with practical skills for developing, debugging, and optimizing JavaScript applications.
To familiarize participants with best practices and advanced JavaScript techniques.

items.text: Introduction to JavaScript and Its Role in Web Development
Understanding JavaScript Syntax and Data Types
Working with Variables, Operators, and Control Structures
Functions and Scope (Local, Global, Lexical)
Object-Oriented Programming with JavaScript (Objects, Prototypes, Inheritance)
Functional Programming Concepts (First-Class Functions, Closures)
Asynchronous JavaScript (Callbacks, Promises, Async/Await)
Error Handling and Debugging Techniques
Working with the Document Object Model (DOM)
Event Handling and Event Delegation
JavaScript and AJAX (Asynchronous Data Fetching)
Introduction to JavaScript Frameworks (React, Angular, Vue)
Making API Requests with Fetch and XMLHttpRequest
Consuming RESTful APIs and Handling JSON Data
Using GraphQL APIs
Integrating Third-Party Libraries and Services
Understanding ES6+ Features (Arrow Functions, Template Literals, Destructuring)
Using Build Tools and Task Runners (Webpack, Babel, npm)
Implementing Code Quality Tools (Linters, Formatters)
Version Control with Git
Writing Unit Tests with JavaScript Testing Frameworks (Jest, Mocha)
Performance Optimization Techniques (Debouncing, Throttling, Minification)
Profiling and Analyzing JavaScript Performance
Best Practices for Writing Efficient and Maintainable Code
Implementing Security Best Practices in JavaScript (XSS, CSRF Protection)
Code Security and Vulnerability Scanning
Best Practices for Secure and Robust JavaScript Applications
Accessibility Considerations and Inclusive Design
